title: SynthForge
summary: A privacy-preserving synthetic healthcare data generation platform with differential privacy, federated learning, and privacy-attack simulation. Its generator service imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to train tabular synthesizers, so SDV is run directly as the CTGAN/TVAE backend.
evidence: backend/services/generator.py:134-147 imports CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata from sdv and trains them
